info.title: Mine-Craft-Protocol V0
info.description: Unstable V0 with explicit READ / OPERATE / TAKEOVER intent, independent authorization, formal Deep Observation and typed Debug. Wire Protocol v1 is not frozen.

port.description: Placeholder only. Read the OS-assigned actual port from the intended instance's minecraft-protocol/endpoint.json; never connect to port 0.

x-minecraft-websocket.description: Existing lifecycle/input/screen events plus explicitly requested USER world.player.state client-tick pose. The pose stream requires read/event, types=[world.player.state] or namespaces=[world], at most once per actual client tick and only a connected local player; default all-events does not include the high-frequency stream. Each pose carries streamContext generation/opaqueId, sourceTick/sample time, xyz/yaw/pitch/onGround/velocityXYZ, no server/NBT fields. Paused gameplay may repeat the same pose; wall-clock rate depends on native tick scheduling and load. Bearer authentication and per-category read authorization are required at publication, replay and send. Old-context frames cannot replay and require gap/resync. Block-change streaming is not implemented. HTTP paths below do not model WebSocket frames.

Returns existing Operation for native dispatch, not world-effect acceptance; explicit cancellation/deadline/close prevents unstarted dispatch, executed effects do not roll back. Accepted Operations are independent of pooled HTTP socket lifetime, bounded to five seconds before dispatch. No implicit retry.

End/expiry drains only the task-bound input Lease; other read/Debug authorization stays independent. Manual Esc ends TAKEOVER input, not the logical task or independent admitted work; reconsent persists. After uncertain delivery inspect status, never blindly replay input.

READ cannot admit new mutations. Never clears manual reconsent.

DEBUG returns the bounded captured UI graph and additionally requires debug and debug.ui.read; no write scope, Arm or input Lease. All three modes allow either independently authorized read category. Authorization and session lifetime are rechecked before publishing; a mode round trip alone does not revoke read authority. Neither view proves full Vanilla UI coverage.

post.description: All commands are USER. action=discover requires read/command scopes in any mode and defaults to bounded CLIENT_LOCAL native roots/completions without packets. Explicit SERVER uses separate transaction IDs and future, human pending completion priority, one request, 250ms minimum interval and 1500ms TTL; server budget remains shared, submitted queries cannot be recalled and cancellation discards results. Neither source proves authorization or execution; it never owns human chat requests. action=batch requires OPERATE/TAKEOVER and command scope, submits 1..32 NATIVE commands sequentially and stops at the first failure; receipts are indexed, not correlated server feedback, atomic or retryable. Default execute: AUTO selects NATIVE in OPERATE, CHAT otherwise; never changes intent. NATIVE uses the actual connected player command API in OPERATE or TAKEOVER with command scope, no input Lease, keyboard, Screen, draft or focus changes. CHAT uses native Chat input under TAKEOVER, command/control/input scopes and existing Lease. Submission is not execution proof; cancellation may leave an already submitted effect. Never grants OP, Debug Arm or missing scopes.

post.description: Explicit independent server authorization; does not establish a mode, input Lease or player permission. Scopes must be a subset of server owner scopes. post.description: USER-only existing client cache pages, never server/NBT/disk or chunk loading. All region block centers remain within 32 blocks of the player at every page. At most 65536 cells per fixed query, 4096 cells per section page, cooperative 8ms owner budget and 16..128KiB payload budget (excluding HTTP envelope). Continuation is single-use on success, bound to authenticated Runtime principal and native world/player/connection epoch, idle 30s/hard 120s. -1 means unloaded, never air; per-page tick/time is not cross-page atomic. READ/OPERATE/TAKEOVER compatible, read scope, no input Lease. At most one page request in flight. Safe read-only retry after structured failure; do not replay a consumed cursor after an uncertain response, restart the read. action=cancel releases only the caller's cursor.

RuntimeInstance.name: X-MCP-Runtime-Instance
RuntimeInstance.description: Pin the startup runtimeInstanceId from per-instance discovery. Checked after Bearer auth and before dispatch, including WebSocket upgrade and binary routes. Mismatch is RUNTIME_INSTANCE_MISMATCH (409). Instance-aware clients must send it; explicit legacy clients remain supported. It grants no authority.

OperationReadCategory.name: category
OperationReadCategory.description: Default USER for player/lifecycle operations. UI/world Debug batch results require explicit DEBUG and their independent ui/debug.ui.read or read/debug.world.read authority plus debug; mixed batches require both. Write scope/Arm grants no read authority. No input Lease is required. All three modes may read independently authorized DEBUG results. USER returns OPERATION_NOT_FOUND; asynchronous publication rechecks category, scopes and session lifetime.

WorldReadCategory.name: category
WorldReadCategory.description: Basic read category, default USER. DEBUG requires read/debug/debug.world.read, no write/Arm/Lease; All three modes allow either independently authorized read category. USER client player/block/entities use the bounded client-known world model without automatic chunk loading; server/internal USER reads fail before capture.

RequestId.name: X-MCP-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Caller correlation ID; generated when absent.

ProtocolVersion.name: X-MCP-Protocol-Version
ProtocolVersion.description: Negotiated unstable protocol version. Defaults to v0.

ExpectedScreenRevision.name: X-MCP-Expected-Screen-Revision
ExpectedScreenRevision.description: Expected Screen revision at input execution start. Rechecked on the native owner thread after acquiring the serial queue turn, before claiming a gesture or dispatching input. A pipeline checks once at execution start; its own later Screen transitions use per-step guards rather than pinning the initial Screen forever. Not an atomic transaction over the complete pipeline.

ExpectedMenuRevision.name: X-MCP-Expected-Menu-Revision
ExpectedMenuRevision.description: Expected global menu revision at input execution start. UI/raw admission and queue-turn execution check the caller's exact value; pipelines check at execution start. Explicit pins also retain the existing strict menu-motion guards. Later self-caused mutations are not a transaction or rollback guarantee; unpinned semantic targets tolerate unrelated slot updates.

blockEntityCursor.description: Opaque continuation from server.blockEntitiesResult.nextCursor. Repeat the same block_entities query, budget and player anchor within 60 seconds. Pages are per-page LIVE, not an atomic snapshot. Only server_authoritative or both.

Native container count includes pending saved entries; collected-to-run and unloaded queues are not included. Array ordering is native iteration, not sorted trigger order.

configuredTickRate.description: Native configured target rate, not measured throughput

passiveWorldDelegationCount.description: Exact native world setter delegation used to distinguish ordinary clock progression from named edits. Included in replacementInjectionCount, not player input or HUD draw delegation.

replacementInjectionCount.description: Sum of actual registered operatorReplacementCount, passiveDrawDelegationCount and passiveWorldDelegationCount. Not an input permission.

UiPresentation.description: Bounded HUD/Toast observations, not semantic player input targets. USER is read-only and excludes hidden/queued content and private DEBUG guards. queuedToastCount.description: DEBUG only; no queued text is exposed in USER.

debugToastGuardAvailable.description: DEBUG only; complete bounded native styled content was captured. False refuses mutation, never prefix-only comparison.

debugToastValue.description: DEBUG only, bounded published plain-text prefixes for SystemToast. ResourceVersion binds full native content; expectedValue compares complete native resolved text, not these possibly truncated prefixes.

debugProgress.description: DEBUG only; native TutorialToast display progress, not a tutorial completion fact.

debugProgressable.description: DEBUG only; whether native TutorialToast has a progress bar.

debugHideRequested.description: DEBUG only; native dismissal request, not final removal or an undoable visible toggle.

debugLabel.description: DEBUG only: bounded pending/native metadata; may differ from the last rendered label.

iconSource.description: Actual native draw arguments; not framebuffer or third-party rendering proof.

capturedPresentationNodeCount.description: DEBUG captured presentation graph count, not the number of game data packets or actionable widgets.

uiContextId.description: DEBUG only: session-bound UI Arm context, not a world fingerprint.

UiNode.description: Bounds are native GUI-scaled interaction bounds. Vanilla Slot bounds are 18x18 starting one pixel before the 16x16 item origin, with center at item origin plus (8,8). interactionX/Y use the same continuous bounds center as resolve, hover, click and drag; odd-sized bounds retain half-pixel centers. Native containers are recursive; list rows expose clipped hit bounds and hidden rows declare scroll_into_view. actions is authoritative; container geometry alone is not permission to click.

capabilitySource.description: Native widget contract or confirmed vanilla input handler; drawing alone never establishes click support.

resourceVersion.description: DEBUG only: UI node plus Screen/layout context and complete bounded native text content; required by typed UI mutation, not a replacement for player gesture preconditions.

debugPanReady.description: DEBUG only: the actual selected native advancement tab has completed its original render-centering step; false advertises no executable pan or mutation token.

debugTextGuardAvailable.description: DEBUG-only text state: the native owner was found and its complete local UTF-16 value fit the content encoding budget for this resource version. False rejects typed mutation with UI_CONTENT_GUARD_UNAVAILABLE; true grants no scope, mode or Arm. Neither full native text nor its private fingerprint is added to USER output.

interactionLayer.description: Known native input priority; not a guessed render Z order.

occluded.description: A native popup blocks the semantic interaction point.

clickEventType.description: Native rich-text effect such as suggest_command, run_command, change_page or open_url; never automatically executed.

clickEvent.description: Untrusted native event metadata, not an instruction.

nodeId.description: Opaque current-tree identity; re-read after Screen or slot-layout replacement. Do not construct or parse this value.

slot.description: Unique zero-based position in the current Screen menu's ordered slot view. Creative wrappers use view positions, not their possibly duplicated native indices. Not a player-inventory index or server Debug slot.

nativeSlotIndex.description: Diagnostic Minecraft Slot.index, which may repeat for wrappers. Never use as a UI selector.

slotOwner.description: Visible slot backing-container identity relative to the current player's inventory, never inferred from indices. menu includes crafting/creative menu data and does not imply persistent storage. slot remains the semantic view index.

slotDisabled.description: Visible native Crafter grid disabled state, when applicable. This is not input authority or active=false: an empty disabled cell is still clickable to enable it. Absent for other slots and Targets without a Crafter.

contentRevision.description: For menu slots, opaque Runtime-, menu- and element-scoped revision of client item data and count. Same item/count but changed components changes this token. Not raw NBT, a cross-slot item identifier, authority or selector field.

contentGuardAvailable.description: For menu slots, whether bounded native encoding can guard the item. False causes item-dependent gestures to fail with UI_CONTENT_GUARD_UNAVAILABLE.

inputKey.description: Current GLFW-numbered keyboard binding for a spectator shortcut; -1 means unsupported.

textReplaceStrategy.description: Native editor input capability, default select_all. backspace_from_end is only declared for append-only editors whose native keyboard route cannot select or move the caret. Replacement remains routed player key input, not a typed Debug setter.

valueComplete.description: Whether the published text is complete within its budget. backspace_from_end replacement requires true and a bounded value; incomplete data never supplies a guessed clear count.

inputRoute.description: Typed native input route. Spectator bounds are display-only; click/select highlights and only explicit activate executes the selected item.

UiSelector.description: Current-tree selector. Multiple matches require nth; selectors are re-resolved before actions.

slot.description: Current-tree UiNode.slot (unique Screen menu view position), not nativeSlotIndex or a server inventory index.

InteractionPoint.description: Continuous GUI-scaled bounds center. Fractional coordinates are preserved through input dispatch; operator pixel rendering may align visually without changing this input point.

interactionPoint.description: Present only for targets with a real mouse hit area.

category.description: USER input only. DEBUG never auto-falls back to player input; use an explicitly supported OPERATE Debug capability instead.

focusOnly.description: Preserve existing caret/selection; reject an unfocused text field instead of clicking it.

text.description: Unicode text through native character callbacks; no control characters. type_text requires a semantic text_field.

replace.description: Select all and replace through native keys, not direct field mutation.

value.description: Normalized native slider fraction; set_value requires a semantic slider.

UiActionRequest.description: Exactly one of selector or coordinates is required by the Runtime.

motion.description: Direct motion is GUI-only and still GAME_ROUTED, authenticated and Lease-bound.

ControlAuthorizationStatus.description: Authenticated session metadata only. No Lease/Arm credentials or world values; contextValidated=false, every owner-thread operation still authorizes independently.

UiMutationSupport.description: DEBUG-only actual native owner applicability. Not permission, not a mutation or UI input. USER projections omit this field.

cursor.description: UTF-16 insertion boundary in input; defaults to input length, never splits a surrogate pair.

completionSource.description: Explicit bounded server suggestions use independent owned transaction IDs; human pending completion wins, at most one Agent request, 250ms minimum interval, 1500ms TTL. Shares native server completion budget, not execution, authorization or correlated command feedback. Default local discovery sends no server completion packet.

commands.description: NATIVE-only sequential submissions; first failure stops subsequent commands. Not atomic, no implicit replay or server-feedback correlation.

route.description: AUTO selects NATIVE only in OPERATE, CHAT otherwise; READ never upgrades. NATIVE requires OPERATE or TAKEOVER and command scope. CHAT additionally requires TAKEOVER, input/control scopes and Lease.

command.description: One command, optional leading slash. The transport budget is 2048 UTF-16 units; the current native Chat limit (including slash) is enforced before input. All five current Targets use 256 units.

configurationKind.description: Present only for an admitted native management-configuration packet; not program execution or generation.

configurationPayloadType.description: Optional for older producers. COMMAND is stored command text; BLOCK_STATE is a Jigsaw final state validated through the current native block-state/command tree; STRUCTURE_PARAMETERS is native Structure update/scan configuration, not file saving or template loading. No raw payload is exposed.

configuredCommandEffect.description: Bounded native-tree effect of a stored program, or STATE_MUTATION for validated Jigsaw block state/Structure parameters. NONE only clears command text. Configuration remains diagnostic and unconfirmed; it does not mean a stored program or template executed.

gestureId.description: Originating bounded input gesture identity, not authorization.

PlayerCommandSubmission.description: Current-player command submission provenance, not server acknowledgement. GAME_ROUTED_RAW can be clean only for non-mutation effects; NORMAL_NETWORK remains contaminated. No command text or internal state.

PlayerCommandFeedback.description: Untrusted client-chat text sampled after native Enter. Temporal association only; may contain unrelated messages or omit delayed feedback. Not server execution acknowledgement.

terminationReason.description: Sampling ended early after the submitted command changed client context. The replacement context was not read; not execution acknowledgement.

PlayerCommandResponse.description: Current-player USER submission receipt, not execution proof. CHAT has GAME_ROUTED_RAW provenance; NATIVE has NORMAL_NETWORK provenance and is not gameplay input evidence. mode is evidence authority, not Control Mode or a granted Debug Arm. State mutation contaminates evidence. Unknown/indirect and host-control commands are rejected before submission and at the final packet boundary.

EventResyncResponse.description: Category-bound resync. UI is available only with ui scope and USER-compatible mode. Operation results use their own authorized routes.

PlayerStateResponse.description: DEBUG basic player response, not USER perception; independent read/debug/debug.world.read and compatible mode required.

BlockStateResponse.description: DEBUG basic block response; USER uses a separate bounded client world model.

targetRef.description: Opaque 15-second client target reference. Not authority; native context, chunk lifecycle, reach and hit are revalidated before USER input.

EntityQueryResponse.description: DEBUG basic entity response; a synchronized set is not a visible entity set.

semanticInference.description: False means entries are render facts, not inferred business controls.

inputGeneration.description: Player-input generation. A strong stop invalidates active/queued work without changing the input Lease.

inputCleanupPending.description: Runtime-owned input cleanup has not finished; not a new permission or control mode.

inputCleanupFailed.description: The most recent required cleanup failed; inspect and do not assume held input is safe.

inputContextGeneration.description: Native world/player/connection epoch; ordinary Screen changes do not advance it.

inputContextId.description: Opaque native context identity, not a permission or resource write token; empty until initialized.

inputContextAvailable.description: A connected native client world and player were present when this epoch was observed.

nativeEntityAttackCount.description: Conservative diagnostic count of actual native entity-attack returns in the Runtime routed processing context with a valid TAKEOVER Lease and matching native epoch. Vanilla queued clicks can be consumed after mouse-up. Not a unique Vanilla call-site proof, damage, animation or server acknowledgement; zero does not prove no attack occurred.

nativeEntityAttackLeaseActive.description: Read-only current attribution check, not an input authorization or Lease grant.

hostCursorCaptured.description: Observed GLFW cursor mode when available. May be true under Vanilla outside TAKEOVER; must be false during TAKEOVER.

hostCursorCaptureGranted.description: Compatibility state, always false: native-click capture grants were removed. Not Vanilla capture state.

nativeCaptureGrants.description: Compatibility counter, zero under exclusive TAKEOVER. Suppressed native input has separate counters.

windowIconState.description: Latest game-supplied icon, with the Agent pointer badge only during TAKEOVER.

windowBaseTitle.description: Latest undecorated title supplied by the game.

windowTitle.description: Last title successfully submitted to the native window backend.

windowDecorationError.description: Empty when no native decoration failure was reported.

hostCursorPolicy.description: Current TAKEOVER policy on supported standard paths, not live capture state or human-verification evidence.

gameCaptured.description: Logical game capture only; never grants host cursor ownership.

gameCursorVisible.description: Effective game visibility request. Operator Pointer also requires TAKEOVER and a GUI.

WorldActualHit.description: Bounded actual client pick or candidate-outline obstruction; does not change pick rules. No NBT, UUID or private gesture guard.

commandSubmissionsComplete.description: For input pipelines, true only when command provenance collection has ended. May remain false after cancellation while native cleanup is pending, or after cleanup failure. Not server execution acknowledgement, effect confirmation or proof that held input is zero. Absent for operations without this source.

result.description: A failed, timed-out, cancelled or still-running input pipeline may expose only type=input.command.provenance and partial=true plus known command provenance. This is not successful step execution, a replayable plan, rollback or server acknowledgement. Other operation result shapes are unchanged.

partial.description: When true on input.command.provenance, this object contains provenance only, not full step results.

additionalScopes.description: Scopes required in addition to the base scope; never granted by a mode or Lease.

additionalScopesByStep.description: Pipeline public step catalog and additional scopes beyond input. Condition steps also enforce the condition domain/category scopes and mode. The entire plan is checked before input and each step is checked again.

InputReleasedCondition.description: Requires independent read and diagnostics scopes in READ, OPERATE or TAKEOVER, including after manual revoke. Accepts only type: no category, expected or selector. True only when Runtime-owned pressedKeyCount and pressedButtonCount are both zero in the observed snapshot. Does not prove the queue will remain idle and grants no input authority.

AutomationCondition.description: Requires read scope, including inside pipelines. input.released is a type-only, mode-independent diagnostic condition additionally requiring diagnostics; category/expected/selector are forbidden, and zero Runtime-owned pressed counts do not imply permanent queue idleness. UI screen/ui.exists/menu/inventory conditions additionally require ui and apply USER/DEBUG UI read scopes and mode rules, with the matching native projection. Event conditions additionally require event. World conditions keep their independent category and permission checks. Async publication rechecks authorization.

ready.description: Require no overlay and positive native/GUI viewport in one owner-thread snapshot. For an open Screen, selector is required and must identify a fresh active/visible target supporting readyAction. With explicit open:false, selector may be omitted: this checks uncovered HUD context, not loaded chunks, world readiness or framebuffer convergence. evidence.readiness explains each tested subcondition from the authorized projection; ASSERTION_FAILED/WAIT_TIMEOUT preserve the same bounded machine reasons. No target reservation.

expected.description: Recursive object subset comparison against the response envelope; JSON arrays compare exactly. Provider payload expectations belong under data. Does not grant category or read scopes.

eventCategory.description: Event family filter, independent of read category

domain.description: Present for categorized UI/world conditions; not inferred from the active mode.

evidence.description: Authorized USER/DEBUG projection for the condition domain.

PipelineStep.description: Versioned V0 macro step. Fields depend on type; unknown types fail before execution. All steps require input, TAKEOVER and the existing Lease. ui.action/ui.drag additionally require ui; wait.until/assert.that additionally require read and the condition domain/category permissions (UI requires ui, event requires event). The entire plan is authorized before input and steps recheck at execution; modes never grant scopes. world.action requires targetRef and action=aim|attack|use|mine|use_hold|place. It serializes with other input, aims through Vanilla relative deltas and freshly picks before routed press. Effects are not guaranteed; confirm with observation. No Debug fallback. mine/use_hold accept holdMs 50..10000 (defaults 5000/1000). place requires face, optional hit u/v 0.05..0.95 and expectedDestinationBlockId. Block use optionally accepts face/hit to select a native sub-surface; these UV values project onto the actual outline, never screen coordinates. Every native held interaction is target/context guarded. Cancel releases input, not rollback: bow release can fire. Mining completion is client prediction only. use_hold hand=main_hand|off_hand (default main_hand); off_hand requires empty main hand, and actual native use hand is verified. Mining tracks bounded synchronous native destruction, including pre-break fluid replacement and neighbor changes; not server confirmation.

read.description: state.read only: USER provider readback; DEBUG remains a separately authorized State Frame. Runs at this step, not atomically with preceding input.

focusOnly.description: type_text preserves caret and refuses an unfocused field; no automatic click.

holdMs.description: world.action: only mine/use_hold accept 50..10000ms; no infinite hold.

text.description: Unicode text through native character callbacks; no control characters. type_text requires a semantic text_field.

replace.description: Select all and replace through native keys, not direct field mutation.

value.description: Normalized native slider fraction; set_value requires a semantic slider.

targetRef.description: For world.action: discovered USER block/entity targetRef; required, never a coordinate fallback.

face.description: world.action place requires this; block use may opt in. Fresh native pick must hit the requested actual native outline surface.

hit.description: Face-local coordinates: up/down u=x v=z; north/south u=x v=y; west/east u=z v=y. Not screen coordinates. Native hit tolerance 0.025 blocks; no input compensation.

entityHit.description: Optional aim/attack/use/use_hold point normalized within the discovered entity native pick box, including its native pick radius. Ray entry and final native hit must agree within 0.025 blocks. Not screen or absolute world coordinates; cannot combine with block face/hit or place/mine.

expectedDestinationBlockId.description: Optional place precondition checked on native BlockPlaceContext destination before press and native invocation.

hand.description: world.action use_hold only; default main_hand. Off-hand requires empty main hand; normal Vanilla hand selection is never bypassed.

UiOffset.description: Normalized point within freshly resolved semantic bounds, not hand-written screen coordinates.

PipelineTiming.description: Successful pipeline elapsed diagnostics only. Excludes HTTP/network overhead and server effect confirmation. Input callback offsets mark the permit-checked native callback entry, not input success. Per-step elapsedMillis includes intentional GUI pacing and holds; stage totals are accumulated durations, not a partition of total time. Existing Operation timestamps are lifecycle-registration metadata, not owner-thread measurements.

firstInputCallbackOffsetMillis.description: Present only when inputCallbackCount is positive; not an input success acknowledgement.

lastInputCallbackOffsetMillis.description: Present only when inputCallbackCount is positive; absent for a delay-only pipeline.

readCategories.description: Supported data categories, independent of currently granted scopes. Server console supports USER; server world internals remain DEBUG.

defaultReadCategory.description: Supported implicit request category. Omitted from descriptors requiring explicit DEBUG. Omitting category in a request never automatically selects DEBUG.

explicitCategoryRequired.description: True for internal-only Providers. Submit explicit DEBUG and its independent read scopes; no automatic privilege upgrade.

uiContextId.description: Client UI session context from DEBUG UI tree; namespaces must be exactly [ui].

worldDiscovery.description: Client-side world catalogue discovery status. A known remote availability/permission failure returns only local CLIENT_UI operations plus this reason; it does not grant world authority. Cancellation, shutdown and unexpected failures still fail the request.

resourceInspection.description: Operation-to-formal-deep-selector/resourceVersion mapping. No Arm required to inspect, but write requires its independent scope, Arm and current resource/value preconditions.

actorUuid.description: Dedicated only: explicit connected actor for player/menu resources.

DebugPlayerStateValue.description: Approved native setters. Current-level experiencePoints is set separately from experienceLevel, below the native level requirement. Velocity is transient. Enabling flying requires existing native mayFly; permission abilities and cumulative totalExperience remain read-only.

flying.description: Native mayFly must already permit enabling flight. This never grants mayFly or changes permissions; normal ability synchronization applies.

DebugEntityStateValue.description: Loaded non-player entity only. Health/absorption require LivingEntity. Native clamps, death and simulation remain in effect. No AI/object/NBT setters.

noAi.description: Loaded Mob only; AI target/brain internals remain read-only.

equipmentSlot.description: Use a key in the entity's actual nativeEquipmentSlots. The native slot and entity applicability are checked before mutation; player equipment remains the six standard slots.

DebugEffectValue.description: Explicit null removes the effect. A typed value replaces the visible instance and bounded same-type hidden chain through native callbacks. Native side effects are not rolled back by cancellation. Incomplete current hidden chains are read-only; no arbitrary entity NBT or factor/blend state.

value.description: Finite base value within the native attribute domain; max-health alias retained.

DebugBlockProperties.description: Native property names (1-64 lowercase letters, digits or underscores) mapped to serialized string values; actual property/value domains are validated before mutation. No NBT or command text.

DebugWorldBlockMutation.description: On the dedicated Runtime, initially supported only for loaded overworld blocks with independently authorized OPERATE, world Arm and this server's current resource version; no console scope or player Lease. Native neighbor effects may be partial when an unloaded dependency is rejected.

properties.description: Optional native overrides. Same block type: amend current state; replacement: amend the new block's default state. Omitted keys are preserved for the same type.

expectedProperties.description: Optional subset value precondition, checked alongside the mandatory full resource version; missing/changed properties reject before mutation.

DebugItemData.description: Closed typed replacement attributes. Unspecified metadata uses native item defaults; not arbitrary NBT/components or a lossless rich-text copy.

mutation.description: Validated against the registered Provider mutation schema.

DebugUiMutation.description: OPERATE or TAKEOVER, debug + debug.write + debug.ui, session-bound UI Arm; typed widget/text/list/slider/canvas mutation, no input Lease or arbitrary callbacks. Value type must match operation. Native text resource versions bind the complete bounded UTF-16 content, not only the published 2048-character prefix. DEBUG text nodes report debugTextGuardAvailable; missing owner or exhausted encoding budget refuses mutation with UI_CONTENT_GUARD_UNAVAILABLE. Text expectedValue compares the complete native string, not its published prefix; this does not change USER input. ui.text.set rejects TestInstanceBlockEditScreen with UI_DEBUG_UNSUPPORTED before changing client text or invoking its management-packet responder. ui.text.set also supports local hud.title/hud.subtitle/hud.actionbar nodes under presentation.children with a UI session Arm, not a world Arm. The resource binds the actual HUD/world/Component identities and complete native styled content plus resolved UTF-16 text, excluding naturally ticking lifetime counters. It sets bounded plain text through native local HUD setters, never player/server input or world mutation; sideEffects=native_hud_plain_text_and_lifetime explicitly does not promise rich-formatting, color-animation or lifetime rollback. USER still excludes hidden/expired messages. ui.scroll.set uses native pixel bounds for AbstractSelectionList; the creative/loom/stonecutter/merchant.scrollbar.track controls use normalized [0,1] local display offsets (only zero when disabled), synchronizing the native row or visible items without selecting a recipe/trade, acquiring items or dispatching player/server input. ui.slider.set requires a finite normalized number in [0,1], invokes the native setter and its setting callback (which may change/persist client settings), and updates the displayed label; it is not player input.

DebugTitleTimesValue.description: DEBUG-only native title timing. The actual HUD/world, complete title/subtitle content and native setter generation are guarded; ordinary countdown is not a revision. Setting times resets the native remaining lifetime, not the game world. ui.hud.title.clear accepts only true and clears native title/subtitle locally; neither action dispatches player input or grants authority.

DebugTitleTimesObserved.description: Exact observed native timing used only as an optional precondition; it is not restricted to the smaller new-write policy.

DebugCanvasPanValue.description: DEBUG-only absolute native GUI offsets, not screen input coordinates or normalized scroll. ui.canvas.pan.set requires explicit finite x/y, an actual initialized selected advancement tab, UI Arm and the current tab/Screen/content resource version. expectedValue uses the same complete two-axis shape. Each enabled axis is bounded by its reported native clamp range; a disabled axis must keep its current centered offset. The native tab scroll method changes local display only, without selecting/unlocking an advancement, input dispatch, packets or a player Lease. Restore by reinspection and an explicit fresh-token mutation; no transaction or automatic rollback.

DebugCanvasPanRange.description: DEBUG-only native local canvas clamp ranges; a non-pannable axis has minimum=maximum=current centered offset, which need not be zero. This metadata grants no permission.

DebugToastText.description: ui.toast.reset explicitly replaces both SystemToast fields as plain text through native reset; reflow, formatting and lifetime may change. It does not restore original rich text or timing. ui.toast.hide requires value=true, requests native one-way dismissal and cannot resurrect a toast. TutorialToast also supports ui.slider.set for finite [0,1] display progress only when progressable. These operations require the existing UI Arm, resident instance/content/lifecycle version, independent scopes and OPERATE or TAKEOVER, never a player Lease or server mutation. Queued/unsupported toast types are not mutation targets; Forge 1.20.1 lacks native SystemToast.forceHide.

DebugRelatedResourceVersions.description: Exactly the affected old/new participant entity_relationship versions, including native automatic dismount or leash removal, no duplicates or ignored extras. Empty array must be explicit when none are required.

allOf.description: Current player only, native non-forced riding, independently requires player and entity scopes/Arm namespaces.

DebugOwnerValue.description: Tamed true requires a non-null loaded real player owner. Native tame callbacks can change attributes/health; relationship restoration is not a transaction rollback.

DebugPlayerTransformMutation.description: Native LIVE teleport, existing dimensions and loaded source/destination bounds only. No command, load request, Lease or input. Independent scopes/Arm and resource version required. Detach ride/leash/camera followers first. Native side effects are not rolled back; own-player dimension change requires fresh fingerprint and Arm.

DebugEntityTransformMutation.description: Native LIVE teleport, existing dimensions and loaded source/destination bounds only. No command, load request, Lease or input. Independent scopes/Arm and resource version required. Detach ride/leash/camera followers first. Native side effects are not rolled back; own-player dimension change requires fresh fingerprint and Arm.

nativeEffectsComplete.description: False when synchronous native block propagation or LIVE transfer was stopped at an unloaded dependency. Applied effects are not rolled back.

postMutationContextChanged.description: UI native responder replaced the Screen; mutation applied, no current-node after token exists.

sideEffects.description: Native slider settings, block updates and LIVE entity transfer retain native callbacks, secondary effects and synchronization; explicit state restoration is not a transaction rollback.

fixtureOperationDuringAct.description: Most recent applied Fixture request in this Act; independent of Debug counters.

contaminated.description: Applied Debug or Fixture work occurred during this Act. Restoring state does not remove contamination.

finalizationFailure.description: Failed stage and bounded diagnostic. Retained source files are not a verified completed Bundle.

RateLimitBudget.description: Limiting token bucket at the admission decision, not a reservation or permission to replay input. Earlier buckets remain charged. Concurrent connection capacity errors are distinct from token rate limits.

category.description: The bucket that rejected admission; requests is the shared request quota.

remaining.description: Whole available tokens at rejection, bounded by capacity.

UiReadiness.description: Machine-only diagnosis from the authorized UI projection. No hidden matches, target labels, tokens or input authority. Missing target means absent or not USER-visible, not proof that hidden content exists.

actualRevision.description: Only for authorized STALE_RESOURCE_REVISION with the same resource identity. Not a token or permission; reinspect instead of blindly retrying.

retryAfterMillis.description: For RATE_LIMITED/EXPENSIVE_OPERATION_RATE_LIMITED HTTP 429: earliest refill estimate for the limiting bucket. Other traffic, deadlines, mode/Lease or lifecycle may still reject a later request. No automatic retry.

executionOutcome.description: Cancellation is not rollback. DEBUG_MUTATION_PARTIAL_NOT_LOADED reports partial with the actual authorized mutation receipt; do not blindly replay.

retrySafe.description: Inspect actual lifecycle/effects instead of replaying cancelled player input.
